---
title: "Welcome"
---

These notes are a **website** of visual mathematical tricks: short maps
of ideas, then figures you can zoom. The layout follows the Quarto
project pattern used in
[Rag-llm-playground](https://github.com/bastienchassagnol/Rag-llm-playground)
(topic folders, shared `_quarto.yml`, freeze for later computations),
but the project type is a [website](https://quarto.org/docs/websites/#config-file),
not a book. There is no PDF target.

## How to read this site {#sec-how-to-read}

1. **Differential equations.** Dynamics as ODEs and equivalent
   mechanical languages: Newton, Lagrange, Hamilton, Hamilton–Jacobi
   ([Differential equations](dynamics/differential-equations.qmd)).
2. **Linear algebra.** How a matrix can be factored, and what each
   factorisation is *for*
   ([Linear algebra](linear-algebra/matrix-decompositions.qmd)).
3. **Analysis.** Calculus on the line, then a first look at complex
   analysis ([Analysis](analysis/calculus-and-complex.qmd)).
4. **Statistics and probability.** Random variables, conditioning, and
   the usual limit theorems
   ([Statistics](statistics/probability.qmd)).

## Build locally {#sec-build}

From the repository root:

```bash
quarto preview         # live HTML
quarto render          # writes HTML under docs/
```

Requirements: [Quarto](https://quarto.org/) 1.8 or newer. Computations
are frozen locally (`_freeze/`) if you later turn `execute.eval` on.

## Repository map {#sec-map}

```text
.
├── index.qmd
├── dynamics/                 # ODEs, dynamical systems
├── linear-algebra/           # decompositions
├── analysis/                 # calculus and complex analysis
├── statistics/               # probability
├── figures/                  # shared images (including Instagram galleries)
├── _freeze/                  # local computation cache (commit if used)
└── docs/                     # rendered HTML (gitignored)
```
